title: RunSummary
description:
One run of one video, as the log viewer's run selector lists it.

A run exists once its log directory does. The outcome comes from the timeline's
run-level record; a run that is still live has none yet.

ended_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant of the terminal record, when there is one.

message.description: The engine's terminal message, when it recorded one.

outcome.description: The run's terminal outcome, or `running` while it holds the lock.

run_id.description: The run id that addresses its log.

started_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the log was opened.

RunOutcome.description: How a run ended, or whether it is still running.

oneOf.description: The run holds the encode lock and has not produced a terminal event.
The user asked the run to stop.
The runner or a sequence reported a failure.
The log predates the run-level timeline record, so its outcome is unknown.
